item.title: SYS010 malware abuses browser management to spy on Gmail, Outlook
item.dc:creator: Ionut Ilascu
item.description: A new version of the SYS01 infostealer malware delivered through Meta ads is enrolling browsers into enterprise-style management to force the installation of an extension that steals sensitive data, including Gmail and Outlook emails. [...]

item.title: Palo Alto Networks warns of Fragnesia flaw exploited in PAN-OS attacks
item.dc:creator: Bill Toulas
item.description: Threat actors are chaining exploits for the PHP2Shell and Fragnesia vulnerabilities to target Palo Alto Networks devices with management interfaces exposed to the internet. [...]

item.title: 1Password customer data stolen after employee GitHub account breach
item.dc:creator: Lawrence Abrams
item.description: 1Password has disclosed a data breach after a an employee's corporate GitHub account was hacked and used to deploy malicious code to the company's backend services to steal customer data. [...]
